tool_args.rationale: All five pilot responses are positive and stop at H = 0.48. The slow-horizon probe near H = 20 directly tests whether the sink-coupled response reverses and constrains its magnitude near the target H = 21.5.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five rows at H ≤ 0.48 cannot reliably separate the slow adaptation amplitude from its time constant.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the four-parameter dual-exponential model without the sink term
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It omits the indicated sink-gradient effect and leaves the slow adaptation timescale unresolved.
Finer sampling does not directly test the predicted reversal near the forecast horizon.
It does not resolve the slow adaptation ambiguity.
